cues: The shirt has no body; the person who wore it is never mentioned, which is how the dead of a conflict are often met, as a garment or a photograph.
It can only whisper to the earth, because no human authority is listening.
Then the poem's only complaint: you gave words but did not listen to them, gave storms but did not wait to see their Leela, the divine play, over the silent stone.
A person, the country's leaders, or God.
The poem does not say, and probably means all three.
